message.content:
I’m sorry—I don’t have access to real‑time market feeds, so I can’t give you the exact spot price of gold as of this moment.  

If you’d like an accurate figure right now, here’s what you can do:

| Source | How to get the price |
|--------|----------------------|
| **Bloomberg** (website & app) | Search “Gold” → Spot Price |
| **Reuters** | Look under commodities > metals |
| **Kitco.com** | Live ticker shows U.S. dollar/ounce |
| **Investing.com / MarketWatch** | Gold section lists daily closing prices |
| **Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED)** | Series FCOGS – “Spot Gold Prices” |

These sites update their quotes within minutes after each trading session ends. If you’re looking at a specific time zone (e.g., New York), remember that most commodity markets close around 5 p.m. ET, and the next day’s opening will reflect overnight changes from London/New York sessions.

Feel free to let me know if you'd like help interpreting those numbers or understanding factors that influence gold pricing!
message.reasoning:
The user asks "What is the gold price today in USA?" We need current data; we don't have real-time capability. According to policy, cannot provide up-to-date info. Must respond with apology and offer general information or how to find it.

We should not use external resources. So answer politely that I can't fetch live data but can explain typical sources like Bloomberg, Reuters, etc., or approximate historical context. Also mention average spot price per ounce. Provide guidance.
